repo.name: nextjs-engine
repo.description: Branch audit workflow config for generator, template, and test-risk analysis.

base_branch_rules.name: component-rendering-bugs-vs-dev-package
base_branch_rules.reason: This branch was cut from dev-package; comparing to local dev-package risks staleness, so prefer the fetched remote-tracking ref. Run 'git fetch' before auditing.

base_branch_rules.name: fix-branches-default-to-master
base_branch_rules.reason: Fix branches are usually compared against master.

base_branch_rules.name: feature-branches-default-to-dev-package
base_branch_rules.reason: Feature work may branch from dev-package.

base_branch_rules.name: dev-package-explicit
base_branch_rules.reason: dev-package should be audited relative to master.

classification_rules.name: shared-helpers
classification_rules.reason: Shared helpers can affect multiple generation paths.

classification_rules.name: shared-rendering-utils
classification_rules.reason: Shared rendering utilities may affect multiple components.

classification_rules.name: page-modules
classification_rules.reason: Page module changes affect generation flow.

classification_rules.name: audit-workflow
classification_rules.reason: Changes affect the repo-local audit workflow.

test_mapping_rules.name: table-template-tests
test_mapping_rules.reason: Table template and component changes should be checked through table generation tests.

test_mapping_rules.name: page-generation-tests
test_mapping_rules.reason: Page generation and shared page helper changes should be checked with page generation tests.

artifact_rules.name: test-output-folder
artifact_rules.reason: Generated test outputs are useful for inspection.

artifact_rules.name: generated-app-pages
artifact_rules.reason: Generated page artifacts should be scanned for output regressions.

artifact_rules.name: source-liquid-templates
artifact_rules.reason: Source Liquid templates should be syntax-checked since a malformed tag will break code generation at runtime.

red_flag_rules.name: Broken use client wrapper
red_flag_rules.description: Generated TSX contains malformed wrapper around the use client directive.

red_flag_rules.name: Empty conditional render artifact
red_flag_rules.description: Generated TSX contains an empty conditional render body.

red_flag_rules.name: Suspicious empty props object
red_flag_rules.description: Generated dropdown/menu items may have rendered with empty props.

red_flag_rules.name: Cannot read properties runtime failure
red_flag_rules.description: Execution failed due to a missing or undefined value.

red_flag_rules.name: Handlebars syntax leaked into output
red_flag_rules.description: Handlebars syntax appeared in generated output where it should have been resolved.

red_flag_rules.name: Malformed Liquid conditional expression
red_flag_rules.description: Liquid tag contains a logical operator (and/or) directly followed by a comparison operator with no left operand - the template will fail at render time.

known_issue_rules.name: Prettier dynamic import under Jest VM constraints
known_issue_rules.pattern: A dynamic import callback was invoked without --experimental-vm-modules
known_issue_rules.description: Known Jest/runtime issue when renderTemplate imports Prettier in this environment.
known_issue_rules.notes: Should be reported but not mistaken for a branch-specific template regression.

known_issue_rules.name: resolveFunctionArgs called with undefined args
known_issue_rules.description: Known helper failure triggered when page templates call resolveFunctionArgs without guarding missing args.
known_issue_rules.notes: Latent helper weakness existed earlier; current crash path appears exposed by LiquidJS page template behavior.

manual_review_checklist: Inspect the highest-risk changed templates or helpers.
Inspect generated page/component output for malformed TSX.
Compare failures against known pre-existing issue patterns.
Confirm whether the branch fixes its intended bug.
Identify which failures are blockers versus follow-up work.
